title: Adams OT winner gives Ridgewood a section title - NewsBreak
text: 1 days ago MORRISTOWN – Heading into overtime of the North Jersey Group 4 section final against Morristown, the Ridgewood players were shellshocked. Not because of that it happened, but rather how it happened. After scoring the go-ahead goal with 48 seconds to play in regulation a deflected Morristown shot ended up in the top-left corner of the net with 4.3 seconds remaining to send the game into overtime. After taking a collective breath, the Maroons came back out onto the field waiting for one of their experienced to come up in the clutch and keep their season alive. Read full article
